# OpenDot

> OpenDot is a free Mac app (macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon and Intel) that gives you a team of AI assistants called Dots. Each Dot has one job, a personality, and only the access you give it. Dots run 24/7 in the background and react to new email, calendar changes, files and webhooks. Your data stays on your Mac. OpenDot is in early access and is not yet available to download.

## Key facts

- Dots: single-purpose AI assistants. You describe the job in plain English, choose what each Dot can touch, and OpenDot gives it a name, a look and a personality.
- SuperDot: asks the right Dots at once and combines their answers, with sources.
- Dot Links: you control which Dots can message which, with role-based access, schedules, rate limits and approvals.
- Private by default: data lives in ~/.opendot on your Mac, emails, phone numbers and card details are masked before reaching cloud models, actions that change things ask first, and keys are kept in the macOS Keychain.
- Any model: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Mistral, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, or local models through Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, or any compatible URL.
- Connections: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive), Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Calendar, OneDrive, Teams), Mac Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Notes and files, unlimited MCP servers, and webhooks.
- Replies stream from the first token.
- Price: free. Status: early access.
